sents.d: Documented outcomes build your case for referrals and future pricing.

Coaching and consulting results are often less immediately tangible than a physical deliverable, which makes intentionally documenting progress and outcomes especially valuable both for the client's own motivation and for your marketing.

scenes.heading: Set a specific goal at the start

sents.d: Defining a clear, specific goal with the client at the start of the engagement — not just a vague direction — makes it possible to genuinely measure and later communicate whether the engagement achieved its purpose.

Checking in periodically on progress toward the original goal, not just how the relationship feels generally, keeps both you and the client honestly oriented toward outcomes rather than just pleasant ongoing conversations.

take: Agree a specific goal and track progress toward it.
